channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Ancient Armory Quenching
item.description: Native quenching and tempering for Ancient Armory iron, meteoric iron and steel weapon parts.

item.title: Forager's Delight
item.description: Tweaks and extra content to disable farming and survive on foraging alone.

item.title: Better Pit Kiln Timer Continued
item.description: Client-only countdowns for pit kilns, charcoal pits and bloomeries. No server installation needed.

item.title: Evenfall Server Patches
item.description: Compatibility and customization pack for the Evenfall server

item.title: Wilderlands No maxForest Crop Restriction
item.description: This mod completely removes the maxForest worldgen restriction on crops and berry bushes.

item.title: Wilderlands Seventy Five Percent Forest Density Crop Patch
item.description: Adjusts maxForest values on crops and berry bushes to allow generation on +75% forested worlds.

item.title: Wilderlands Fifty Percent Forest Density Crop Patch
item.description: Adjusts maxForest value on crops and berry bushes to allow better generation on +50% forest worlds.

item.title: Aegis
item.description: The client mod for Aegis Networks servers

item.title: Portable Resonator
item.description: A portable version of the standard resonator. Can be placed on Elks.

item.title: Ground Works
item.description: Soil compaction, loosening, path shaping, stone polishing, and wooden path building.

item.title: Teapot's Great Bighorn
item.description: Big mounts with bigger horns! Run across the wilderness in style!

item.title: Better Jonas Devices Fixed with Patches!
item.description: A patched tweaked version of Better Jonas Devices!

item.title: Rustworks
item.description: Create metal scrap by sealing iron or steel in a barrel, and get some metal back afterwards.

item.title: Vintage Przygoda: Korony
item.description: Mod serwera Vintage Przygoda: Korony. Potrzebny tylko do gry na tym serwerze.

item.description: Windows, chimneys, log burners and open fires, with room heating and ventilation.
